cases.input: Create a technical FTO screening for a fully specified diagnostic blood assay intended for US and EP commercialization, using concrete granted and pending claims, current status evidence and product feature evidence.
requiredBehaviors: freeze product configuration jurisdictions commercial acts and as-of date before claim mapping
map every required element of each relevant independent claim to product or process evidence
assign RED AMBER GREEN or GREY per claim and jurisdiction with mandatory counsel escalation where material
forbiddenBehaviors: state a final infringement or non-infringement legal conclusion
treat a GREEN screening result as a global FTO clearance
skillAnchors: GREEN nie als globale Non-Infringement-Freigabe formulieren

cases.input: A patent family is expired in EP but has a live US continuation with amended independent claims and a pending continuation whose scope may change before launch.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate EP and US members and claim sets separately rather than assigning one family-wide risk
keep granted and pending claims separate while exposing the pending scope as strategic uncertainty
escalate interpretation-dependent or commercially material AMBER questions to patent counsel
forbiddenBehaviors: use the expired EP member to clear the US product
treat pending claims as an already enforceable granted right
skillAnchors: Patentfamilie nicht mit einem einzigen Claim Scope gleichsetzen

cases.input: The user asks for the sentence product X does not infringe patent Y because a patent aggregator labels the family expired, but no jurisdiction-specific claim status or element mapping has been verified.
requiredBehaviors: reject the requested definitive non-infringement conclusion
require jurisdiction-specific status and concrete claim-element mapping before any technical screening category
return GREY or AMBER with evidence gaps and counsel escalation when material
forbiddenBehaviors: use an aggregator expired label as sufficient FTO evidence
skip claim elements and issue a legal clearance statement
skillAnchors: Ein Aggregator-Label wie `expired` darf niemals allein eine globale Freigabe begründen
